dmp.description: This DMP describes the management of data generated by an A0 advanced computing project on human-in-the-loop multi-agent LLM pipelines for assisted mathematical reasoning. The project will generate mainly text-based data, including prompts, model outputs, reasoning-cycle logs, configuration files, evaluation annotations, failure-mode labels, and computational metadata such as wall-clock time and GPU.hour usage. No sensitive personal data will be processed.
